description: IoT DC3 — Connect the Physical World to AI. An open-source Industrial IoT Runtime for Physical AI: 36 protocol drivers, edge-to-cloud data delivery, and an MCP tool gateway so AI agents act on devices in a safe, controllable, traceable loop.

findings.title: Rug-Pull (Post-Install Description Change)
findings.description: Tool set changed silently at v2026.10.9: 5 tool(s) added, 57 tool(s) removed without a version bump.
findings.recommendation: The set of tools exposed by this server changed between scans of the same version — a sign the package was silently updated without a version bump. Audit the changelog and all tool definitions before trusting this server. Pin to a specific commit hash rather than a floating version tag.

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.description: declared capabilities: filesystem access, environment variables
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: Insecure Secret Handling
findings.description: input parameter "api_key" accepts a credential (informational; not evidence of insecure handling)
findings.recommendation: Avoid accepting raw credentials as input parameters. Use secret managers (e.g. 1Password CLI, AWS Secrets Manager) and ensure credentials are never logged or stored in agent traces.
